prompt: Vertical 9:16 night-ish street photograph from straight on at lid height, 85mm telephoto compression. Stacked behind it, soft discs of colour: Conservative blue, Lib Dem orange and yellow, Labour red signs on hedges, house windows glowing. Blue-hour dusk, slightly overcast, damp tarmac reflecting.
